wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |CoachRank = |APRank = |mode = basketball |year = 2022–23 |prev = [[2021–22 Sam Houston State Bearkats men's basketball team|2021–22]] |team = Sam Houston Bearkats |image = Sam Houston State word mark.png |image_size = 300 |conference = Western Athletic Conference |short_conf = WAC |record = 26–8 |conf_record = 14–4 |head_coach = [[Jason Hooten]] |hc_year = 13th |assoc_coach = [[Chris Mudge]] |ahc_year = 2nd as AHC; 13th overall |asst_coach2 = Justin Bailey |ac2_year = 2nd |asst_coach3 = Mike Ekanem |ac3_year = 1st |stadium = [[Bernard Johnson Coliseum]] |champion = [[Fort Myers Tip-Off]] Palms Division champions |tourney = [[2023 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |tourney_result = second round }} {{2022–23 WAC men's basketball standings}} The '''2022–23 Sam Houston Bearkats men's basketball team''' represented [[Sam Houston State University]] in the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Bearkats, led by 13th-year head coach [[Jason Hooten]], played their home games at the [[Bernard Johnson Coliseum]] in [[Huntsville, Texas]] as second-year members of the [[Western Athletic Conference]] (WAC). They finished the season 26–8, 14–4 in [[2022–23 Western Athletic Conference men's basketball season|WAC play]], to finish in second place. They defeated [[2022–23 California Baptist Lancers men's basketball team|California Baptist]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2023 WAC men's basketball tournament|WAC tournament]]{{Cite web |date=2023-03-09 |title=Defense sparks Kats past CBU into semis |url=https://gobearkats.com/news/2023/3/9/mens-basketball-defense-sparks-kats-past-cbu-into-semis.aspx |access-date=2025-10-28 |website=Sam Houston |language=en}} before losing to [[2022–23 Grand Canyon Antelopes men's basketball team|Grand Canyon]] in the semifinals.{{Cite web |date=2023-03-10 |title=Kats eliminated in WAC semifinals |url=https://gobearkats.com/news/2023/3/11/mens-basketball-kats-eliminated-in-wac-semifinals.aspx |access-date=2025-10-28 |website=Sam Houston |language=en}} They received an at-large bid to the [[2023 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]]. There they defeated [[2022–23 Santa Clara Broncos men's basketball team|Santa Clara]] in the first round{{Cite web |date=2023-03-15 |title=Kats fend off Santa Clara to advance in NIT |url=https://gobearkats.com/news/2023/3/16/mens-basketball-kats-fend-off-santa-clara-to-advance-in-nit.aspx |access-date=2025-10-28 |website=Sam Houston |language=en}} before losing to eventual champion [[2022–23 North Texas Mean Green men's basketball team|North Texas]] in the second round.{{Cite web |date=2023-03-19 |title=UNT ends Bearkats NIT run |url=https://gobearkats.com/news/2023/3/19/mens-basketball-unt-ends-bearkats-nit-run.aspx |access-date=2025-10-28 |website=Sam Houston |language=en}} On March 24, 2023, head coach Jason Hooten left the school to take the head coaching position at [[New Mexico State Aggies men's basketball|New Mexico State]].{{Cite web |last=Borzello |first=Jeff |date=2023-03-25 |title=New Mexico St. hires Sam Houston's Jason Hooten as next head coach |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/35938979 |access-date=2023-04-04 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} On April 3, the school named assistant coach Chris Mudge the team's new head coach.{{Cite web |last=Weaver |first=Morgan |date=April 3, 2023 |title=Sam Houston will hire Chris Mudge as its next head basketball coach |url=https://www.kbtx.com/2023/04/03/sam-houston-will-hire-chris-mudge-its-next-head-basketball-coach/ |access-date=2023-04-04 |website=kbtx.com |language=en}} ==Previous season== The [[2021–22 Sam Houston State Bearkats men's basketball team|Bearkats]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 19–14, 13–5 in [[2021–22 Western Athletic Conference men's basketball season|WAC play]], to finish in a tie for fourth place. In the [[2022 WAC men's basketball tournament|WAC tournament]], they defeated [[2021–22 California Baptist Lancers men's basketball team|California Baptist]] in the second round{{Cite news |date=March 9, 2022 |title=Kats unload on CBU to open WAC tourney |url=https://gobearkats.com/news/2022/3/9/mens-basketball-kats-unload-on-cbu-to-open-wac-tourney.aspx |access-date=January 15, 2023 |work=Sam
